correctness.rationale: Independently cancelled the coboundary for V=log x+y/(1-a) on x>0: V(F)-V=(c-c*)/(1-a)-Phi(x/x*), Phi(u)=u-1-log u>=0 and x*=(1-a)/(1-a+b). Compact exact invariance F(K)=K gives bounded bi-infinite histories; below the fold a positive history would force V arbitrarily large backwards despite compact upper bound. The axis x=0 has only the one bounded entire affine orbit. On x>0, any point with sufficiently small x in the support of a compact invariant measure shrinks x by at least 1/2 forward forever, so is nonrecurrent; Poincare recurrence removes mass near x=0, justifying otherwise problematic integrability of log x. Integration yields exact expectation. At equality, Phi=0 forces x=x* and the x equation forces y=x*-log x*. Nonzero x>0 component plus the invariant axis exhaust invariant probability support (no negative x has invariant mass). The concentration bound follows from convex defect monotonicity and Markov. Equilibrium fold is verified from strictly convex qx-t log x, but known prior art.
